verdict.rationale: Wise documents its own rule mechanism: Spend Controls let users create rules based on merchant category code or transaction currency that automatically permit or block card transactions as they occur [wise-docs-32]. Card spending-permission toggles [wise-docs-30] add adjacent support. This is a narrow, allow/deny-only rule set for one event type rather than general event-triggered automation. Webhook subscriptions [wise-docs-33] are only a developer building block for constructing automation, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general rules engine with configurable triggers across event types (transfers, incoming payments, balance changes), configurable actions beyond card allow/deny (e.g., auto-convert, auto-transfer, notify), and hands-on corroboration.
